# yellowdog_machine_image (Resource)

Describes a machine software image, its capabilities and where it is available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A machine image registers a cloud provider's image, such as an AWS AMI, in an
# image group, so that compute requirements can select it by family or group.
resource "yellowdog_machine_image_family" "example" {
  name      = "example-image-family"
  namespace = "example-namespace"
  os_type   = "LINUX"
  access    = "PRIVATE"
}

resource "yellowdog_machine_image_group" "example" {
  family_id = yellowdog_machine_image_family.example.id
  name      = "v1"
  os_type   = "LINUX"
}

resource "yellowdog_machine_image" "example" {
  group_id          = yellowdog_machine_image_group.example.id
  name              = "ubuntu-22.04-eu-west-2"
  cloud_provider    = "AWS"
  os_type           = "LINUX"
  provider_image_id = "ami-09dbc7ce74870d573"
  regions           = ["eu-west-2"]

  supported_instance_types = ["t3a.micro", "t3a.small"]
  metadata = {
    "os.version" = "22.04"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) The compute provider in whose system the image is registered.
- `group_id` (String) Id of the MachineImageGroup this MachineImage belongs to
- `name` (String) The machine image name
- `os_type` (String) The image operating system type
- `provider_image_id` (String) The ID for the image in the compute provider's system.

### Optional

- `metadata` (Map of String) A map of user-definable key-value pairs to hold extra metadata properties related to the machine image.
- `regions` (List of String) The regions in which the image is registered. If null or empty then the image is assumed to be available in all regions.
- `supported_instance_types` (List of String) The instance types that can be used with the image in the cloud provider's system. If null or empty then the image is assumed to compatible with any instance type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the machine image's YDID.
terraform import yellowdog_machine_image.example ydid:image:000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
